description:
Goal
Repair the expected fz-hwn.20.4 functionality before publishing seam-specific codegen facts. Boundary contracts must be complete facts derived by the new transport calculator, not lossy summaries or old-model recovery.

Required behavior
Callable-shaped leaves crossing a published boundary are represented by one concrete published value lane. Tuple return contracts remain tuple contracts instead of collapsing to one broad return lane. Direct call surfaces and first-class boundary publication remain separately observable for the same callable when both obligations exist.

Source rule
Use source-level worked examples before implementation. Use semantic evidence, settled demand, callable surfaces, capture types, producer return sources, and shared ShapeId descriptors. Do not use old RuntimeValueLayout/DeliveredShape/ReturnAbi/NativeDemandAbi or codegen ArgRepr as authority.

Checks
Tests inspect actual BoundaryDescr and CallableFacts contents, not just counts. Telemetry reports zero/empty codegen seam facts until fz-hwn.20.5 creates them. outline.md and proposal.html describe the corrected boundary-contract status.
title: Transport flow graph: complete callable boundary contracts before seam facts
